sourceHtml:
To transcribe a podcast, content creators first need to decide whether to manually write out their audio or turn to artificial intelligence. For those who want to save time and smooth the post-production process, the latter option is typically the better choice.

Transcribing podcast audio into text extends a show’s reach, improves search results, and improves access for every listener. Whether you create an independent interview series or oversee corporate media networks, creating a robust and repeatable podcast transcription workflow will help you transform raw media into adaptive content in a fraction of the time.

This guide explains the fundamentals of how to transcribe a podcast with AI, outlining step-by-step processes, publishing criteria, and methods for repurposing content.

Summary

  • Podcast transcription converts episode audio into written text, complete with speaker labels and timestamps, enhancing your show's accessibility and searchability.
  • A dependable workflow begins with an audio file you possess and concludes with a review before exporting.
  • AI transcription delivers a complete episode within minutes, while a human review improves accuracy for challenging audio or critical quotes.
  • SRT and VTT files are ideal for podcast apps and captions, while plain text or HTML files are better suited for your website and blog.
  • Both Apple Podcasts and Spotify accept transcripts provided by creators. Having a complete transcript on your episode page gives search engines the full text of the conversation.

What podcast transcription is and why it matters

Podcast transcription is the process of converting a podcast episode's spoken audio into written text. A complete transcript identifies who is speaking and marks when each segment begins. Both human and AI transcription services generate transcripts, and many creators use a combination of the two.

Creators transcribe their episodes for four practical reasons:

  • Accessibility: A transcript gives deaf and hard-of-hearing listeners full access to your content and episodes. It also serves the type of listener who prefers to read or skim content.
  • Search visibility: Text is indexed by search engines for better visibility. A transcript posted on your episode page provides search engines like Google with the complete content of the conversation for ranking purposes.
  • Content repurposing: Transcripts provide the foundational content used to craft show notes, blog entries, newsletters, and posts for social media.
  • Searchable archives: With a repository of transcripts, your team and listeners can easily find the precise episode where a subject was mentioned.

The level of platform support has increased the stakes. Apple Podcasts auto-generates transcripts for new episodes and lets listeners tap any line to play the audio from that point. Spotify shows transcripts in its mobile app for eligible creators. Your transcript now sits right beside the episode, making it a part of the listening experience.

How to transcribe a podcast: Step-by-step workflow

You can transcribe a podcast episode in five steps: export the audio, choose a method, upload and configure, review the output, and export the final file. Each step below stands on its own, so you can return to the one you need.

Step 1: Export the episode audio

Start with an audio file you own or have the rights to transcribe. That is usually the master export from your recording software or the published file from your podcast host. Use the highest-quality version available, since clean audio gives the model the clearest signal.

If your hosts and guests recorded on separate microphones through a mixer or a remote recording platform, keep the multi-track or multichannel file. It unlocks cleaner speaker separation in step 3. ElevenLabs accepts AAC, AIFF, OGG, MP3, OPUS, WAV, FLAC, M4A, and WebM audio, plus video files for video podcasts, up to 3GB per file in the web app. Standard mode accepts recordings of up to 10 hours long.

Step 2: Choose your transcription method

Assess whether the AI transcription is accurate enough on its own or if the episode should undergo a human review process. A solo performance captured in a treated space typically requires just a brief self-assessment. A panel of six people recorded via video calls might require additional resources. 

Podcast transcription software and podcast transcription services differ in turnaround time and in how they handle difficult audio. Here are the main benefits of choosing human or AI podcast transcription:

  • AI podcast transcription: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 transcribes audio and video files in over 90 languages and bills by the hour of audio you send.
  • Human transcription services: Professional transcription services manually review every line of your podcast, which pays off for dense jargon or when you need quotes that must be exactly intact. However, turnaround time will be longer, and the per-minute cost of transcription will be significantly higher. 

A hybrid review of human and AI may suit some creators best, as it allows you to produce high-quality transcripts at speed while still saving on cost. 

Step 3: Upload and configure

In ElevenCreative, open Speech to Text, click Transcribe files, and upload your episode. Before you submit, set the options that match your recording:

  • Language: Leave this on Detect for multilingual episodes, or choose the primary language if you know it.
  • Speaker diarization: Scribe detects and labels each speaker automatically and supports up to 32 speakers in one file.
  • Multichannel transcription: When each speaker sits on a separate channel, the API processes every channel independently and assigns a speaker ID by channel number, for up to five channels.
  • Keyterm prompting: Add guest names, your show name, sponsor names, and recurring jargon so the model spells them correctly. Batch transcription accepts up to 1,000 key terms and adds 20% to the base transcription cost.
  • Audio event tagging: Turn on Tag audio events to mark laughter and applause.
  • Clean output: Through ElevenAPI, set no_verbatim to remove any filler words and false starts. 

Step 4: Review and edit the output

Open the finished transcript in the Transcript Editor. Click any word to play the audio from that point, then correct misheard names and reassign any lines attributed to the wrong speaker. The editing section below covers verbatim and clean output in more depth. Check the Transcription Editor Guide for more editing details.

Step 5: Export in the format you need

Click Export and pick the format for your destination. An HTML or plain text file suits your episode page, and an SRT or VTT file suits captions and podcast platforms. The formatting and publishing sections below explain which file goes where.

How to best record podcast audio for accurate transcripts

Features like no_verbatim go a long way to producing a final transcript that’s legible and accurate. However, for best results, incorporate the following habits into your recording process before you upload:

  • Record each speaker separately: Where possible, use a separate microphone and track for each individual person. Then transcribe with multichannel transcription for cleaner speaker separation across all of your guests. 
  • Avoid talking over one another: Episodes with crosstalk or loud music can be hard to transcribe. Where possible, speak in turn.
  • Transcribe a voice-only export: Loud music can make speech harder to transcribe. Upload a mix without music or sound effects when you have one. 
  • Add brand and guest names with keyterm prompting: Add your brand name and guest names to your pronunciation dictionary. Adding keyterms allows for more accurate transcription. 

How to format a podcast transcript

A transcript presented as a continuous block of text is difficult to read and quote, even if every word in it is accurate. A great podcast transcript breaks the conversation down into short speaker-labeled segments with timestamps. From there, you can export that to the file type your destination expects. 

Timestamp

Speaker

Text

00:00:04

Host

Welcome back to the show. Today we are talking about how small teams plan a release calendar.

00:00:11

Guest

Thanks for having me. We started by mapping every launch to one shared calendar.

00:00:19

Host

[laughter] That sounds like a lot of color coding.

ElevenCreative supports exporting transcripts in a range of formats. Identify the choice that aligns with where the transcript will be stored. The formats listed in the Transcript Editor guide are:

Format:

Best used for:

Plain text

Drafting show notes and blog posts

HTML

Publishing the full transcript on your episode page

SRT or VTT

Captions for video podcasts and transcript uploads to Apple Podcasts and Spotify

JSON

Developers who need word-level timing data for search tools or custom players

The Speech to Text product guide also walks through the upload and export options in ElevenCreative.

How to add speaker labels, timestamps, and audio context

Speaker labels enhance the readability of a transcript. Scribe v2 detects each voice in a shared recording and automatically marks the speaking turns through diarization. When your setup records each person on a separate mic and track, multichannel transcription gives cleaner separation. Every channel corresponds to a single speaker, allowing the model to assign each word to its originating track. Once transcribed, change generic labels such as speaker_0 to the names of your host and guest.

By adding timestamps, a transcript becomes easier to navigate. Scribe v2 provides timestamps at the word level, while the API additionally supports timing at the character level. This level of precision drives tap-to-play transcripts in podcast applications, letting users skip straight to the start of a topic. Spotify also needs timestamps in the uploaded transcript files to keep the text synchronized during playback.

Audio context ensures the conversation's tone remains consistent. Switch on audio event tagging to detect non-verbal sounds like applause and laughter. In interviews and comedy shows, the audience's reaction forms part of the content, and including a tag like [laughter] captures that moment for readers of the text format.

Edit for accuracy without losing the speaker's meaning

Start the editing process by selecting either verbatim or clean output. Scribe v2 features a no-verbatim mode that eliminates filler words and creates a more fluid reading experience. Verbatim output retains every word exactly as spoken.

Apply this guideline when making your choice:

  • Clean transcripts: Use them for show notes and blog repurposing, where readability matters most.
  • Verbatim transcripts: Use them for news and legal podcasts, or for any episode where a guest's exact words might be quoted or scrutinized. If you publish a clean version of a sensitive episode, check every quote against the verbatim transcript first.

The Transcript Editor in ElevenCreative allows you to correct mistakes while listening to the audio. Select any word to begin playback from that position, then enter your correction directly. You can split and combine segments, move timestamp handles, assign segments to another speaker, and reduce playback speed for difficult-to-hear sections. Once you have edited a segment, choose Align words to recalculate its word-level timestamps.

Publish podcast transcripts on podcast platforms and your website

To maximize the reach of your transcripts, distribute them strategically across platform apps and your owned web domain. Each channel uses distinct technical protocols to display text to listeners.

Apple Podcasts allows creators to supply custom transcript files directly through RSS feeds using the <podcast:transcript> namespace tag. Creators can also upload SRT or WebVTT files directly within Apple Podcasts Connect. Note that these creator-provided files are separate from Apple's native in-app auto-transcripts, which are read-only and cannot be exported. See Apple’s transcripts guide for more details.

Spotify automatically generates transcriptions for select shows, but coverage across catalog episodes remains variable. Providing your own verified transcript through your RSS feed helps ensure Spotify displays accurate text that reflects your actual show content. For more information, read Spotify’s podcast transcripts guide.

Publishing the complete transcript on your official website episode page remains a reliable strategy for search engine indexation. Embedding written text directly on your domain ensures search engines index your episode content, driving organic web traffic independently of platform shifts.

Platform specifications and RSS feed requirements change over time. Production teams should always verify the current technical documentation provided by Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and their podcast hosting service before deploying new RSS tags.

Repurpose podcast transcripts for SEO, clips, and social posts 

Only a few listeners read an entire transcript from beginning to end. Its greatest value is serving as the foundation for all other content you create about the episode. Since the text includes timestamps and speaker labels, you can trace every derived segment to the exact point in the audio.

  • Blog posts: Turn a strong 10-minute segment into a standalone article. Edit the spoken answers to written form while keeping the guest's key phrasing, then link back to the episode.
  • Social posts: Pull quotable lines directly from the transcript. Scribe's timestamps are word-level; you can confirm the exact wording and find the matching audio in seconds.
  • Chapter markers: Scan the transcript for topic shifts and note their timestamps. Chapters help listeners navigate long episodes, and Apple Podcasts uses them to break transcripts into sections.
  • Clip selection: Use the JSON export's timing data to locate powerful moments, such as a laugh line or a sharp answer, before you open your video editor.

The full transcript on your episode page remains its own search asset, separate from any derivative content. A blog post might target one keyword, while the complete transcript captures the long-tail phrases your guests used naturally. For more information, look at other ways content creators use speech to text.

ElevenLabs supplies the accurate, time-stamped transcript that makes this repurposing possible. Cutting video clips and designing social graphics happen in separate editing tools.

Get started with ElevenCreative for podcast transcription

ElevenCreative gives you the full podcast transcription workflow in your browser. Upload an episode to Speech to Text, then review the result in the Transcript Editor before exporting to the formats Apple Podcasts and Spotify accept. Scribe v2 transcribes more than 90 languages and is the default model in the web app.

Developers can build the same workflow into a podcast hosting platform or publishing pipeline with the Speech to Text API. The API adds options such as multichannel transcription and webhooks for long files.

Start transcribing your podcast today. Try the ElevenLabs podcast transcript generator on your latest podcast episode.

要转录播客，内容创作者首先需要决定是手动将音频写成文字，还是借助人工智能。对于希望节省时间、让后期制作流程更顺畅的人来说，后者通常是更好的选择。

将播客音频转录成文字，可以扩大节目的覆盖范围，改善搜索结果，并让每位听众都更方便地获取内容。无论你是在制作独立的访谈系列，还是管理企业媒体网络，建立一套完善、可重复执行的播客转录工作流程，都能帮助你用少得多的时间，将原始媒体素材转化为适合不同用途的内容。

本指南讲解如何使用 AI 转录播客的基础知识，介绍具体步骤、发布标准以及内容再利用的方法。

摘要

  • 播客转录将单集音频转换为带有说话人标签和时间戳的书面文字，提升节目的无障碍程度和可搜索性。
  • 可靠的工作流程始于你持有的音频文件，并在导出前以审核收尾。
  • AI 转录可在几分钟内完成一整期节目，而人工审核能提高复杂音频或重要引语的准确性。
  • SRT 和 VTT 文件非常适合播客应用和字幕，而纯文本或 HTML 文件更适合网站和博客。
  • Apple Podcasts 和 Spotify 都接受创作者提供的转录稿。在单集页面提供完整转录稿，可以让搜索引擎获取对话全文。

什么是播客转录，为什么它很重要

播客转录是将播客单集中的口述音频转换为书面文字的过程。完整的转录稿会标明谁在说话，并标注每个片段的开始时间。人工和 AI 转录服务都能生成转录稿，许多创作者会将两者结合使用。

创作者转录节目，主要出于四个实际原因：

  • 无障碍访问：转录稿让聋人和听力障碍听众能够完整获取你的内容和节目，也能满足偏好阅读或浏览内容的听众的需求。
  • 搜索可见性：搜索引擎会将文字编入索引，从而提高内容的可见性。在单集页面发布转录稿，可为 Google 等搜索引擎提供完整的对话内容，用于搜索排名。
  • 内容再利用：转录稿为制作节目说明、博客文章、电子通讯和社交媒体帖子提供基础内容。
  • 可搜索的档案：有了转录稿库，你的团队和听众就能轻松找到提及某个话题的具体单集。

平台支持程度的提升，让转录稿变得更加重要。Apple Podcasts 会自动为新单集生成转录稿，听众点按任意一行，即可从对应位置播放音频。Spotify 会在其移动应用中展示符合条件的创作者的转录稿。如今，转录稿就显示在单集旁边，成为收听体验的一部分。

如何转录播客：分步工作流程

转录一集播客可以分为五步：导出音频、选择方法、上传并配置、审核输出结果，以及导出最终文件。下面每一步都可独立参考，方便你随时返回所需的部分。

第 1 步：导出单集音频

首先准备一个你拥有或有权转录的音频文件。通常是录音软件导出的母版文件，或播客托管平台上已发布的文件。请使用可获取的最高质量版本，因为清晰的音频能为模型提供最清楚的信号。

如果主持人和嘉宾通过调音台或远程录音平台，使用各自独立的麦克风录音，请保留多轨或多声道文件。这样在第 3 步就能更清晰地区分说话人。ElevenLabs 网页应用接受 AAC、AIFF、OGG、MP3、OPUS、WAV、FLAC、M4A 和 WebM 音频，也接受视频播客的视频文件，每个文件最大为 3GB。标准模式接受最长 10 小时的录音。

第 2 步：选择转录方法

评估AI 转录是否准确到足以直接使用，还是需要对该单集进行人工审核。在经过声学处理的空间录制的单人节目，通常只需简短自查。通过视频通话录制的六人讨论节目，可能需要投入更多资源。 

播客转录软件和播客转录服务在交付时间及处理复杂音频的方式上有所不同。以下是选择人工或 AI 播客转录的主要优势：

  • AI 播客转录：ElevenLabs Scribe v2 可转录超过 90 种语言的音频和视频文件，并按你提交的音频小时数计费。
  • 人工转录服务：专业转录服务会逐行人工审核播客内容，在专业术语密集，或需要完全保留原话的引语时，这种方式很有价值。不过，交付时间会更长，每分钟转录成本也会显著提高。 

对一些创作者而言，将人工与 AI 结合的混合审核方式可能最合适，因为它既能快速产出高质量转录稿，又能节省成本。 

第 3 步：上传并配置

在 ElevenCreative 中打开 Speech to Text，点击 Transcribe files，然后上传节目。提交前，根据录音情况设置以下选项：

  • 语言：对于多语言节目，保留 Detect 设置；如果知道主要语言，也可以直接选择。
  • 说话人分离：Scribe 会自动检测并标记每位说话人，单个文件最多支持 32 位说话人。
  • 多声道转录：当每位说话人各占一个独立声道时，API 会独立处理每个声道，并根据声道编号分配说话人 ID，最多支持五个声道。
  • 关键术语提示：添加嘉宾姓名、节目名称、赞助商名称和反复出现的专业术语，让模型正确拼写这些词。批量转录最多接受 1,000 个关键术语，并在基础转录费用上加收 20%。
  • 音频事件标注：开启 Tag audio events，以标记笑声和掌声。
  • 精简输出：通过 ElevenAPI 设置 no_verbatim，以去除填充词和说到一半重新起头的表达。 

第 4 步：审核并编辑输出结果

在 Transcript Editor 中打开已完成的转录稿。点击任意单词，即可从对应位置播放音频，然后纠正识别错误的姓名，并将归属错误的语句重新分配给正确的说话人。下方的编辑部分会更深入地介绍逐字输出和精简输出。更多编辑细节，请参阅转录编辑器指南。

第 5 步：按所需格式导出

点击 Export，选择适合目标发布渠道的格式。HTML 或纯文本文件适合单集页面，SRT 或 VTT 文件适合字幕和播客平台。下方的格式与发布部分会说明各类文件分别适用于哪些渠道。

如何录制播客音频，以获得准确的转录稿

no_verbatim 等功能对生成易读且准确的最终转录稿很有帮助。不过，为获得最佳效果，请在上传之前，将以下习惯融入录音流程：

  • 分别录制每位说话人：尽可能为每个人使用独立的麦克风和音轨。然后使用多声道转录，更清晰地区分所有嘉宾的发言。 
  • 避免相互抢话：包含重叠说话声或响亮音乐的节目可能很难转录。尽可能轮流发言。
  • 转录仅含人声的导出文件：响亮的音乐会增加语音转录难度。如果有不含音乐或音效的混音版本，请上传该版本。 
  • 通过关键术语提示添加品牌和嘉宾姓名：将品牌名称和嘉宾姓名添加到发音词典中。添加关键术语可以提高转录准确性。 

如何设置播客转录稿的格式

即使每个字都准确，将转录稿呈现为连续的大段文字，也会让阅读和引用变得困难。优秀的播客转录稿会将对话拆分为简短片段，并标注说话人和时间戳。之后，你可以将其导出为目标渠道所需的文件类型。 

时间戳

说话人

文字

00:00:04

主持人

欢迎回到节目。今天我们来聊聊小团队如何规划发布日程。

00:00:11

嘉宾

感谢邀请。我们一开始就把每次发布都安排到同一个共享日历上。

00:00:19

主持人

[笑声] 听起来得用不少颜色来标记。

ElevenCreative 支持将转录稿导出为多种格式。请根据转录稿的存放位置选择合适的格式。转录编辑器指南列出的格式包括：

格式：

最适合的用途：

纯文本

起草节目说明和博客文章

SRT 或 VTT

为视频播客提供字幕，以及向 Apple Podcasts 和 Spotify 上传转录稿

适用于需要词级时间数据来构建搜索工具或自定义播放器的开发者

这份 Speech to Text 产品指南也介绍了 ElevenCreative 中的上传和导出选项。

如何添加说话人标签、时间戳和音频情境信息

说话人标签能提高转录稿的可读性。Scribe v2 会检测同一段录音中的不同声音，并通过说话人分离自动标记发言轮次。如果你的录制配置为每个人配备独立的麦克风和音轨，多声道转录就能更清晰地区分发言。每个声道对应一位说话人，因此模型可以将每个词归到其来源音轨。转录完成后，将 speaker_0 等通用标签改为主持人和嘉宾的姓名。

通过添加时间戳，转录稿会更便于导航。Scribe v2 提供词级时间戳，API 还额外支持字符级时间信息。这种精度支持播客应用中的点按播放转录稿功能，让用户能直接跳到某个话题的起点。Spotify 也要求上传的转录稿文件包含时间戳，以便在播放时保持文字同步。

音频情境信息能确保对话的语气得到一致呈现。开启音频事件标注，即可检测掌声、笑声等非语言声音。在访谈和喜剧节目中，观众反应也是内容的一部分，加入 [笑声] 这样的标签，能让阅读文字版的读者捕捉到这一瞬间。

在不丢失说话人原意的前提下编辑，提高准确性

开始编辑时，先选择逐字输出或精简输出。Scribe v2 提供 no-verbatim 模式，可去除填充词，使阅读更流畅。逐字输出则会原样保留说出的每一个词。

选择时请遵循以下准则：

  • 精简转录稿：用于节目说明和改编为博客文章等最重视可读性的场景。
  • 逐字转录稿：用于新闻和法律类播客，或任何嘉宾原话可能被引用或仔细审视的节目。如果要为涉及敏感内容的单集发布精简版，请先对照逐字转录稿核查每一处引语。

ElevenCreative 中的 Transcript Editor 允许你边听音频边纠正错误。选择任意单词，即可从该位置开始播放，然后直接输入修正内容。你可以拆分和合并片段、移动时间戳控制柄、将片段分配给另一位说话人，并在难以听清的部分降低播放速度。编辑完某个片段后，选择 Align words，重新计算该片段的词级时间戳。

在播客平台和你的网站上发布播客转录稿

为最大程度扩大转录稿的覆盖范围，请有策略地将其分发到平台应用和自有网站域名。各渠道使用不同的技术协议向听众展示文字。

Apple Podcasts 允许创作者通过 RSS 订阅源，使用 <podcast:transcript> 命名空间标签直接提供自定义转录稿文件。创作者也可以直接在 Apple Podcasts Connect 中上传 SRT 或 WebVTT 文件。请注意，这些由创作者提供的文件，与 Apple 应用内原生的自动转录稿相互独立；后者为只读，无法导出。更多详情，请参阅 Apple 的转录稿指南。

Spotify 会为部分节目自动生成转录稿，但对节目目录中各单集的覆盖情况仍不一致。通过 RSS 订阅源提供你自己核验过的转录稿，有助于确保 Spotify 展示准确、反映节目实际内容的文字。更多信息，请阅读 Spotify 的播客转录稿指南。

在官方网站的单集页面发布完整转录稿，仍然是让搜索引擎将内容编入索引的可靠策略。将书面文字直接嵌入你的域名下，可确保搜索引擎索引节目内容，带来自然搜索流量，而不受平台变化的影响。

平台规范和 RSS 订阅源要求会随时间变化。在部署新的 RSS 标签之前，制作团队应始终核实 Apple Podcasts、Spotify 和播客托管服务提供的最新技术文档。

将播客转录稿再利用于 SEO、短片和社交媒体帖子 

只有少数听众会从头到尾读完整份转录稿。它最大的价值，是为你围绕该单集创作的所有其他内容提供基础。由于文字包含时间戳和说话人标签，你可以将每个衍生片段追溯到音频中的确切位置。

  • 博客文章：将精彩的 10 分钟片段改写为一篇独立文章。在保留嘉宾关键措辞的同时，将口头回答编辑为书面表达，然后添加指向该单集的链接。
  • 社交媒体帖子：直接从转录稿中提取值得引用的语句。Scribe 的时间戳精确到词，你可以在几秒内确认确切措辞，并找到对应音频。
  • 章节标记：浏览转录稿，找到话题转换处并记下时间戳。章节能帮助听众浏览较长的节目，Apple Podcasts 也会使用章节将转录稿划分为多个部分。
  • 短片选段：在打开视频编辑器之前，使用 JSON 导出文件中的时间数据，定位引人入胜的时刻，例如一句笑料或一个犀利的回答。

单集页面上的完整转录稿本身仍是一项搜索资产，独立于任何衍生内容。博客文章可能针对某个关键词，而完整转录稿则涵盖了嘉宾自然使用的长尾短语。更多信息，请查看内容创作者使用语音转文字的其他方式。

ElevenLabs 提供准确且带有时间戳的转录稿，让这种内容再利用成为可能。视频短片剪辑和社交媒体图片设计则在其他编辑工具中完成。
